Subject: Project Update: New Delivery Date of 14 April

The third-party integration required for this project has taken longer to certify than the vendor originally projected, which has moved our delivery date by two weeks. We now expect to complete and hand off the project on 14 April.

We have already adjusted our internal schedule to absorb this delay without affecting the quality of testing or the remaining milestones, and our team is continuing development on every component that does not depend on the certification. We will send a short progress note each Friday between now and delivery so you can track exactly where things stand.

Does 14 April still work well with your own downstream plans, or is there a specific date on your end we should be designing around?
